note: Both profiles are checked against production via independent night-order and year-basis options. Profile IDs are reference labels, not API parameters. Example timezone is an explicit test assumption, not a supplied birthplace.

morinus.adapter: Only nine vocabulary labels for mtexts; original module unchanged; date precision and UTC-midnight comparison only; 3 Feb-29 exceptions retained in external review

temporal.scope: Six UTC leap-birth configurations from fixed 144-combination cohort. Exact nominal microsecond arithmetic only; no physical UTC/leap-second or prediction claim.

birchfield.author: Steven Birchfield
birchfield.scope: Literal tables conflict at 16 Mercury/Venus positions with the paper governing rule and Doser/Dykes Fig.7. Retain these differences, do not copy them into engine order.

doser_dykes.author: Oner Doser; edited by Benjamin Dykes
doser_dykes.title: Astrological Prediction: A Handbook of Techniques
doser_dykes.scope: Named period years, two night placements, seven equal shares and Chaldean sublord order; not certification of a unique modern UTC year.

default_reference.scope: One existing synthetic Shanghai request, explicit day sect from historical fixture, new clocks computed independently by actual Temporal. Historical fixture supplies vocabulary only. No new natal/physical/predictive credit.

historical_vocabulary_reference.role: Vocabulary and prior counterexample only; new clocks independently computed by actual Temporal.

vendor_diagnostic.scope: Published no-node example shares first 70 years only. UTC display and 365.2425 days are a matching interpretation, not verified vendor settings or exact timestamp acceptance. Original differences and unsupported restart retained in external review.

third_party.model_revision: fixed_365_2425 now uses nominal UTC elapsed time; calendar_anniversary remains civil birthday boundaries. All calls now declare calculation_options; legacy DST behavior is not preserved.
